theorem lg_target : (Finset.filter (fun n => n % 3 = 0) (Finset.range 30)).card = 10 := by
  have : Finset.filter (fun n => n % 3 = 0) (Finset.range 30) = Finset.range 30 ∩ {n | n % 3 = 0} := by rw [Finset.filter_eq_inter]
  rw [this]
  have : {n | n % 3 = 0} = {0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 27} := by rfl
  rw [this]
  have : Finset.range 30 ∩ {0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 27} = {0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 27} := by rfl
  rw [this]
  exact rfl
